dedupe_keys.name: data accompanying chapter 4 of the phd dissertation energy system design and operation of hydrogen fuelled ships

description: TU Delft provides MATLAB representative operating-profile synthesis scripts and Python lifetime-cost and stability optimisation code for hydrogen-based ship systems. Algorithmic RDP-based and probability-based downsampling methods reduce operating profiles. Python code combines a representative power profile with available engine-room component-placement positions. The source identifies SCIP through PySCIPOpt and describes effects of ship stability and placement constraints on system design. Coverage: No complete measurement interval or evaluation extent is stated in the reviewed source. Access: public native metadata describes the release and its formats. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost and current distribution access remain unknown. Caveats: The bundle accompanies Chapter 4 of the dissertation. Retrofit energy management and weather-driven demand are retained as distinct related resources. Solver feasibility, physical stability calculations and cost outcomes were not independently tested.
inputs: Vessel operating profiles and available engine-room component positions.
name: Data accompanying Chapter 4 of the PhD Dissertation: Energy System Design and Operation of Hydrogen Fuelled Ships
